class.name: OcgGraphic3dTexture2dplane
class.brief_description: This class allows the management of a 2D texture defined from a plane equation Use the SetXXX() methods for positioning the texture as you want.
class.description: ! This class allows the management of a 2D texture defined from a plane equation ! Use the SetXXX() methods for positioning the texture as you want.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a texture from a predefined texture name set.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a texture from the pixmap.

method.name: SetPlaneS
method.description: Defines the texture projection plane for texture coordinate S default is <1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0>

method.name: SetPlaneT
method.description: Defines the texture projection plane for texture coordinate T default is <0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0>

method.name: SetPlane
method.description: Defines the texture projection plane for both S and T texture coordinate default is NOTP_XY meaning: <1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0> for S and <0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0> for T

method.name: SetScaleS
method.description: Defines the texture scale for the S texture coordinate much easier than recomputing the S plane equation but the result is the same default to 1.0

method.name: SetScaleT
method.description: Defines the texture scale for the T texture coordinate much easier than recompution the T plane equation but the result is the same default to 1.0

method.name: SetTranslateS
method.description: Defines the texture translation for the S texture coordinate you can obtain the same effect by modifying the S plane equation but its not easier. default to 0.0

method.name: SetTranslateT
method.description: Defines the texture translation for the T texture coordinate you can obtain the same effect by modifying the T plane equation but its not easier. default to 0.0

method.name: SetRotation
method.description: Sets the rotation angle of the whole texture. the same result might be achieved by recomputing the S and T plane equation but it's not the easiest way... the angle is expressed in degrees default is 0.0

method.name: Plane
method.description: Returns the current texture plane name or NOTP_UNKNOWN when the plane is user defined.

method.name: PlaneS
method.description: Returns the current texture plane S equation

method.name: PlaneT
method.description: Returns the current texture plane T equation

method.name: TranslateS
method.description: Returns the current texture S translation value

method.name: TranslateT
method.description: Returns the current texture T translation value

method.name: ScaleS
method.description: Returns the current texture S scale value

method.name: ScaleT
method.description: Returns the current texture T scale value

method.name: Rotation
method.description: Returns the current texture rotation angle
